description: This file defines the License class within the Goteo project's model layer. It manages license data, including fetching, listing, saving, validating, deleting, and reordering licenses along with their associated icons. It interacts with database tables such as 'license', 'license_lang', and 'icon_license'.

classes.name: License
classes.description: Represents a license entity, providing methods for retrieval, listing, validation, saving, deletion, and reordering of licenses in the database.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a license by ID, including associated icons, optionally in specified language.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns all licenses, optionally filtered by icon or group, with localization considerations.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Provides a simple list of all licenses, localized.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates license data, ensuring the name is set.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Validates and saves the license object to the database, handling related icons.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a license by ID, including associated icon relationships.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Moves the license up in order for display purposes.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Moves the license down in order for display purposes.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Calculates the next order number for new licenses.
